description: Search published employment-law rulings from our research corpus by keyword, law, court, federal circuit, state, outcome, and date. Returns published opinions with citations, outcomes, procedural stage, employers, claim types, damages, and links to the full opinion. Use this to ground any claim about how employment cases have been decided. Results are quality-filtered (low-confidence and junk rows excluded).

circuit.description: Filter to a federal appeals circuit (the appeals court plus its district courts). Preferred values: first-circuit, second-circuit, third-circuit, fourth-circuit, fifth-circuit, sixth-circuit, seventh-circuit, eighth-circuit, ninth-circuit, tenth-circuit, eleventh-circuit, dc-circuit, federal-circuit. Display forms like "Eleventh Circuit" or "11th" are also accepted.

court.description: Filter by CourtListener court id, e.g. "scotus", "ca11" (11th Circuit).

law.description: Filter by a related law id, e.g. "title-vii", "adea", "ada", "fmla", "flsa".

outcome.description: Filter to a specific case outcome.

query.description: Free-text search across case name and opinion snippet (e.g. "pregnancy discrimination retaliation").

state.description: Two-letter US state code the case was filed in, e.g. "FL", "CA".

name: search_rulings
title: Search employment-law rulings
